Q: Troubling to export step file A:

# ===================== CONFIGURE THESE =====================

$searchRoots = @(

"C:\\CADData",        

"D:\\Projects\\CATIA"

)

$catiaExe = "C:\Program Files\Dassault Systemes\B34\intel_a\code\bin\CATIA.exe"

# ===========================================================

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms

# Step 1: Check clipboard

$name = [System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::GetText().Trim()

$name = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($name)

[System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox]::Show(

"Step 1 - Copied name from clipboard:\`n$name", 

"CAT Launcher Debug")

if (-not $name) {

\[System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox\]::Show(

    "Clipboard is empty! Copy JT part name first.", 

    "CAT Launcher Debug")

exit

}

# Step 2: Show short name being searched

$shortName = $name.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(10, $name.Length))

[System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox]::Show(

"Step 2 - Searching with first 10 characters:\`n$shortName", 

"CAT Launcher Debug")

# Step 3: Check folders exist

foreach ($root in $searchRoots) {

if (Test-Path $root) {

    \[System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox\]::Show(

        "Step 3 - Folder found OK:\`n$root", 

        "CAT Launcher Debug")

} else {

    \[System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox\]::Show(

        "Step 3 - FOLDER NOT FOUND:\`n$root\`n\`nThis path does not exist on your PC!", 

        "CAT Launcher Debug")

}

}

# Step 4: Search for file

$found = $null

foreach ($root in $searchRoots) {

foreach ($ext in @(".CATPart", ".CATProduct")) {

    $result = Get-ChildItem -Path $root -Recurse \`

              -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | 

              Where-Object { $\_.Name -like "$shortName\*$ext" } | 

              Select-Object -First 1

    if ($result) {

        $found = $result.FullName

        break

    }

}

if ($found) { break }

}

# Step 5: Show result

if ($found) {

\[System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox\]::Show(

    "Step 4 - File found!:\`n$found", 

    "CAT Launcher Debug")

Start-Process -FilePath $catiaExe -ArgumentList "\`"$found\`""

} else {

\[System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox\]::Show(

    "Step 4 - File NOT found!\`n\`nSearched for: $shortName\*\`nIn folders: $($searchRoots -join ', ')", 

    "CAT Launcher Debug")

}
